zh.title: 無線網路的信任邊界：連上 Wi-Fi 之後
zh.summary: 接入無線網路、信任對方身分與保護應用資料，是不同層次。把每一段的保護範圍畫清楚。
objectives: 解釋 SSID 為何不能單獨證明網路身分。
區分無線鏈路保護與端到端 TLS。

sections.heading: 名稱與訊號不是可信身分
paragraphs: SSID 是網路名稱，不是無法仿冒的身分證。看到熟悉名稱或強訊號，不能單獨證明接入點屬於預期組織。應依已核對的組織設定與支援流程連線；遇到憑證警告應停止並確認。
無線安全需要盤點接入點、設定、用戶端與監控。訪客與內部系統分離可縮小暴露，但隔離是否有效還需實際驗證，不能只因為使用不同名稱就假設已隔離。

sections.heading: 每段加密有自己的端點
paragraphs: 無線鏈路保護通常涵蓋用戶端與接入點之間；TLS 則保護應用通訊端點之間。兩者的範圍不同。即使 Wi-Fi 有密碼，也不能省略網站的 HTTPS 與正確身分驗證。
正確 TLS 也不保證網站內容或意圖可信。判斷應同時保留網路接入、傳輸保護與應用授權三層，避免把一個鎖頭當成所有安全問題的答案。

example.title: 例子：兩個同名訪客網路
example.scenario: 虛構場地出現兩個 Cafe-Guest。使用者只因其中一個訊號較強就打算登入工作帳號。
example.reasoning: 訊號強弱只描述接收狀況；名稱可以重複。先向既有可信場地資訊核對網路，並依工作裝置政策處理。
example.conclusion: 不把同名或強訊號當成身分確認。

lab.title: 紙上練習：畫兩段保護
lab.environment: 只畫網路圖，不建立接入點、不擷取流量。
steps: 畫出裝置→接入點→網際網路→網站。
標示無線鏈路與 TLS 的端點。
在每一層寫一個仍需核對的信任問題。
lab.expected: 兩種保護範圍不同；網站與接入點身分需各自處理。
lab.check: Wi-Fi 密碼能否證明網站有權讀你的工作資料？
lab.cleanup: 保留圖即可，沒有網路設定變更。

en.title: Wireless trust boundaries: after connecting to Wi-Fi
en.summary: Joining a wireless network, trusting a peer and protecting application data are separate layers. Draw the boundary of each protection.
objectives: Explain why an SSID alone does not establish network identity.
Distinguish wireless-link protection from endpoint-to-endpoint TLS.

sections.heading: A name and signal are not trusted identity
paragraphs: An SSID is a network name, not an unforgeable identity. A familiar name or strong signal does not independently prove that an access point belongs to the expected organization. Connect using verified organizational settings and support procedures; stop and verify certificate warnings.

Wireless security includes inventory, configuration, clients and monitoring. Separating guests from internal systems can reduce exposure, but isolation needs verification. Different network names alone do not prove separation.

sections.heading: Each encrypted segment has its own endpoints
paragraphs: Wireless-link protection typically covers the client-to-access-point segment; TLS protects communication between its application endpoints. These boundaries differ. A Wi-Fi password does not remove the need for HTTPS and proper peer verification.

Correct TLS does not establish trustworthy content or intent. Keep network access, transport protection and application authorization separate rather than treating a lock icon as an answer to every security question.

example.title: Example: two guest networks with the same name
example.scenario: A fictional venue shows two Cafe-Guest networks. A user plans to enter a work account through whichever has the stronger signal.
example.reasoning: Signal strength describes reception, and names can be duplicated. Verify the network through trusted venue information and follow the work device’s policy.
example.conclusion: Do not treat a matching name or strong signal as identity verification.

lab.title: Tabletop exercise: draw two protection boundaries
lab.environment: Draw only; do not create access points or capture traffic.
steps: Mark the wireless-link and TLS endpoints.
Write one remaining trust question for each layer.
lab.expected: The two protections cover different boundaries; website and access-point identity need separate consideration.
lab.check: Can a Wi-Fi password establish a website’s permission to read work data?
lab.cleanup: Keep the diagram; no network configuration changed.

zh.prompt: SSID 與公司名稱相同，能直接信任嗎？
options: 不能，還需可信設定與身分核對
不能，所以任何無線網路都不可用
rationales: 名稱不足以建立可信身分。
訊號強度不是授權證據。
適當驗證與控制仍可支援安全使用。

en.prompt: Can an SSID matching the company name be directly trusted?
options: No; trusted configuration and identity checks remain necessary
Yes, if the signal is strong
No, so no wireless network is usable
rationales: Names can be repeated or imitated.
A name alone does not establish trusted identity.
Signal strength is not authorization evidence.
Appropriate verification and controls can support safe use.

zh.prompt: Wi-Fi 已有鏈路保護，HTTPS 是否仍有作用？
options: 有，它保護不同端點間的傳輸
有，它自動保證所有網站內容正確
rationales: 接入網路不證明網站可信。
TLS 提供應用通訊端點之間的保護。
加密與身分機制不保證內容正確。

en.prompt: Does HTTPS still matter when Wi-Fi has link protection?
options: No; the website must be trusted
Yes; it protects transport between different endpoints
Yes; it guarantees all website content is correct
rationales: Network access does not establish website trust.
TLS protects communication between its endpoints.
Encryption and identity mechanisms do not guarantee content correctness.
